newsitem.title: KENYA: Rwanda national assembly speaker dismissed - radio.
newsitem.headline: Rwanda national assembly speaker dismissed - radio.

text.p: The speaker of Rwanda's Transitional National Assembly was dismissed on Monday after a vote of no confidence, state-run Rwanda radio said.
Juvenal Nkusi of the Hutu majority had held the post for 26 months. Tutsi-led rebels seized power in July 1994, ending a three-month genocide by Hutu troops, militiamen and mobs.
Elections for a new speaker would be held within 15 days and in the interim the assembly's secretary would be in charge, said the radio, monitored by the British Broadcasting Corporation.
The broadcast gave no reason for the vote of no confidence in Nkusi.
